h1: Golden & Kicking Horse ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Kicking Horse rises 1,315 metres above Golden in the Columbia Valley, and 60% of its terrain is graded advanced or expert. The resort counts over 85 inbound chutes, the Golden Eagle Express gondola runs 3,413 metres in twelve minutes, and the summit stations record 750 cm of snow a year.
stayOverview: The resort base is at the gondola; the town of Golden is fourteen kilometres away in the Columbia Valley and has most of the beds.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The base is ski-in but small; the town is cheaper and has the restaurants.
rentalCars: Golden is on the Trans-Canada Highway between Banff and Revelstoke, and a car is needed between the town and the lifts.
